<thought>Using the most intense m/z 235.1395 as [M+H]+ gives a neutral mass of ~234.132 Da. Matching this exact mass to plausible formulas suggests C₁₄H₁₈O₃ as the best fit (within a few ppm) and consistent with the observed ~16 % M+1 isotopic intensity (≈14 C). No additional hetero‑atoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
